schema.id: string — unique identifier, e.g. opp-0001, immutable once assigned
schema.source: string — one of the 19 sources in opportunity-sources.md, e.g. Upwork, LinkedIn Jobs, UAE Recruiters
schema.sourceCategory: string — one of: Marketplace, Professional Network, Recruiter Channel, Consulting Channel, Compliance Programme, Technology Practice, Direct/Referral
schema.title: string — role, engagement or opportunity title as found
schema.organisation: string — company, agency or body name
schema.description: string — raw description as found, unedited
schema.url: string or null — link to the original listing
schema.remote: boolean — true if the posting explicitly allows remote delivery
schema.domainTags: array of strings — any of: ADGL, AI Deployment Governance, AI Governance, GRC, Technology Risk, Third-Party Risk, Security Governance, DORA, EU AI Act, ISO 42001, Fractional Advisory, Government/FedRAMP-GovRAMP-CMMC — used to build the domain-filtered report views

scores.timeRequired: number — 0-10, inverted: 10 = least time to pursue

schema.relevanceScore: number — 0-100, per opportunity-relevance-engine.md; every entry here already cleared the relevance threshold (50) — opportunities that didn't are in runtime/rejected/rejected-log.json instead, never here
schema.classification: string — one of: Apply, Immediate Proposal, Follow Recruiter, Relationship Building, Partnership, Ignore, Convert into Content, Convert into Product Idea
schema.scopedEngagement: boolean — is this a named, scoped engagement rather than a general lead? Set at ingestion (see runtime/ingest.py's INPUT FORMAT), used both to classify and, downstream, by sales-director/runtime/prepare.py to decide pricing and send-readiness
schema.routedTo: array of strings — downstream files this entry was written to on classification, e.g. ['08-Revenue-Hunter/pipeline.json', '06-CRM/company-intelligence.json']
schema.status: string — new, routed, in-progress, proposal-sent, won, lost, archived
schema.autoCollected: boolean — true if this entry came from the autonomous collection engine (runtime/collect.py) rather than manual entry
schema.autoScored: boolean — true if the eleven scores are heuristic estimates from a scraped posting, not a human judgement; treat as a starting point to verify, not a finished score
schema.matchedKeywords: array of strings — which configured keywords (runtime/config/keywords.json) matched this posting, present only for auto-collected entries

opportunities.title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
opportunities.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

opportunities.title: IT Manager
opportunities.description:
Job Title: IT Manager

Location:This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

About Us

1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.

We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans, go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.

Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a hands-on IT Manager to manage 1mindâs internal technology, from laptops and logins to software purchases and vendor contracts. Weâre adding people, tools and compliance requirements fast, and this role makes sure everyone has what they need on day one, every dollar we spend on software is the right call, and we stay secure and continuously audit ready as we scale. This is an individual contributor role, a great fit for a hands-on doer who likes scaling systems and wants real ownership to steward this rocketship to the next level.

What Youâll Do

  • Be the go-to for all employee IT needs. Scale and run our help desk with a service mindset, and keep policies, runbooks and the knowledge base current

  • Own the employee IT lifecycle, from devices and day-one access through offboarding. Manage SSO, SCIM provisioning and least-privilege access across our apps, and fix sync issues as they come up

  • Manage hardware inventory and core infrastructure, including our identity provider, Google Workspace, MDM and networking

  • Own every tool from request to retirement. Run evaluations, lead selection in partnership with department leads and stakeholders, negotiate terms with Finance and Legal, then handle deployment, licensing and decommissioning

  • Keep our vendor register and renewal calendar current so nothing auto-renews by surprise. Cut tools that are redundant, underused or overspending, including on AI/LLM usage

  • Partner with the GRC team on SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA. Run vendor security assessments and access reviews, enforce controls like MFA, and support audits and incident response

What Youâll Bring

  • 5+ years (or equivalent experience) in IT operations, systems administration or IT management, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS or tech company

  • Hands-on experience administering an identity provider (SSO and SCIM across many SaaS apps), Google Workspace and an MDM/endpoint platform

  • A track record of sourcing software, negotiating vendor contracts and managing a SaaS budget

  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and comfort supporting audits with clean evidence and documentation

  • Strong organization and a service mindset, with the ability to juggle tickets alongside bigger projects and a bias for automating the fix over closing the same ticket twice

  • Bonus points if youâve used Rippling, SentinelOne, Atlassian, Vanta, or Ramp, if youâve been the first or only IT hire at a startup, or if youâve worked with ISO 42001 or AI governance

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help define a new category at one of the most exciting moments in enterprise AI. Youâll work alongside a team of builders who move quickly, take ownership, and care deeply about solving meaningful problems. If youâre energized by ambiguity, excited to shape whatâs next, and want your work to have an outsized impact, weâd love to meet you!

The salary range for this position is $140,000 to $170,000. The compensation package for this position also includes stock options and company-paid benefits.

1mind's total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. The hiring manager will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through the process.

We believe in providing interesting and meaningful work in a supportive and inclusive environment - free from discrimination for everyone without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you are passionate about learning and excited about what we are doing, then we want to hear from you!

[Please note that all legitimate communication from 1mind will come only from email addresses ending in @1mind.com. We will never ask for payment, financial information, or personal details outside of our official application process. If you receive a suspicious message, please disregard it and alert us at careers@1mind.com]

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. opportunities.title: Sr. Security Operations Manager
opportunities.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

Carrot is looking for a senior, hands-on security leader to run our security operations and help set the direction for how we adopt AI safely in this space. In this player-coach role, you will own how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats, and you will secure the corporate and AI tools our employees rely on every day. You will build where it has the most impact: detection logic, automation, and AI agents that allow a small team to operate at scale.

AI runs through this role. Our teams work across collaboration platforms, enterprise search, workflow automation, AI assistants, and custom agents connected to internal systems, and each one changes how sensitive data moves. You will make sure we adopt these tools quickly and safely, and you will use AI to automate as much of the security pipeline as possible.

Much of this job happens between teams. You will partner with IT, Legal, Privacy, and Engineering, and you will get partner teams to meet security commitments through influence rather than authority. As part of the Information Security team, you will also contribute to privacy, vendor risk, compliance, and customer assurance in a healthcare environment.

Â 

What Youâll Own ð¼

In this role, you will:

  • Own the security incident lifecycle, from intake and triage through containment, communication, and post-incident review. Act as incident commander, run tabletop exercises, and coordinate with Legal and Privacy on breach notification.
  • Manage our managed security provider: hold them to SLAs, own escalation and handoffs, and tune what they alert on so alerts turn into action. Revisit what stays outsourced as our automation matures.
  • Own our detection and investigation program in our SIEM. Build detections and AI-assisted investigations that scale without pulling in Engineering, and automate the incident pipeline end to end, including case notes, executive summaries, daily reporting, and retrospectives.
  • Own the security configuration of our corporate stack (identity, endpoint, productivity suite, and secure access), with IT handling day-to-day administration. Own email security (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC), threat and brand intelligence, phishing simulations, and security awareness training.
  • Secure the collaboration AI tools and agents our employees use. Set repeatable standards for credential and secrets management, least-privilege data access, human approval for consequential actions, and audit logging, and maintain an inventory of approved AI tools so the sanctioned path is the easiest one.
  • Track vulnerabilities and threats relevant to Carrot, including attacks on AI systems, and coordinate the response. Set remediation SLAs, report on how well they are met, and manage the annual third-party penetration test through to closure.
  • Support the broader Information Security team on application and product security, third-party vendor risk (with added scrutiny of AI vendors), AI governance, compliance and audit readiness, customer security assessments, privacy partnership with Legal and our Data Protection Officer, and policy and continuity planning.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Within your first 90 days, taken ownership of incident response and the managed security provider relationship, reviewed detection coverage in our SIEM, built a first inventory of AI tools and agents in use, and identified the biggest gaps in our operational and AI security.
  • Matured incident response with documented runbooks and regular tabletop exercises, with clear communication paths to Legal, Privacy, and executive leadership.
  • Expanded detection coverage and improved alert quality, with measurable gains in time to detect and time to respond.
  • Automated the major steps of the incident pipeline with AI and agents, including investigation, case notes, executive summaries, and daily reporting.
  • Established repeatable standards for AI tool and agent security (credentials, data access, human approval, and audit logging) that partner teams follow.
  • Set vulnerability remediation SLAs, reported on how well they are met, and driven annual penetration test findings to closure.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • 7+ years in security operations, including SIEM-based detection and investigation in a cloud SaaS environment.
  • Experience leading security incidents as incident commander, including executive communication and coordination with Legal.
  • Hands-on experience securing corporate identity, endpoint, and email systems, such as Okta, Google Workspace, and CrowdStrike.
  • Experience managing an MSSP or MDR provider to SLAs.
  • AI fluency: a track record of building security automation with AI or agents, and daily use of AI tools in your own work.
  • The ability to influence partner teams without authority and explain technical risk in business terms.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment handling PHI or payment data, including HIPAA/HITECH compliance.
  • Experience securing AI agents and integrations, including familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.
  • Experience with threat or brand intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HITRUST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) and AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or OSCP. None are required.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrot protects some of the most personal information people share: their health, their families, and their path to parenthood. Employers, health plans, and health systems trust us with that responsibility, and that trust depends on a security program that is strong, responsive, and honest about risk.

As AI becomes part of how every team works, this role will shape how Carrot adopts it safely. You will build the practices, automation, and partnerships that let us move quickly without putting member data at risk, and you will do it as a hands-on leader whose work is visible across the company.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Technical Interviewâ 60 minutes
  4. Team Culture Chatâ 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up â 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Â 

Compensation Â ð°

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $167,000-$185,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Â 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

Â 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirementâand we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators. Carrotâs global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortuneâs Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.Â

opportunities.title: Knowledge Engineer
opportunities.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States.

The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

Benefits:

Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Opportunity to develop and implement innovative solutions that improve employee productivity and customer experiences. Significant ownership and influence over AI architecture, knowledge management standards, and automation strategy. Professional development opportunities through continuous exposure to emerging AI tools, technologies, and practices.
